messages:
Rina (Marketing): Need a tight, one-page enterprise brief for next week's webinar. Must cover security/compliance, SLA choices, deployment modes, and two short benchmark bullets. Want it ready to attach in registration and follow-up.
Ethan (Product): I'll supply the canonical SLA wording and two latency bullets. Note: we should avoid exact kernel or model internals.
Priya (Solutions): Include a small decision flow: "Which deployment fits you?" with 3 endpoints: Hosted -> fast onboarding, Dedicated -> reserved throughput, Private -> VPC/on-prem with KMS. Simple icons only.
Marco (Sales): For inbound lead routing, propose: est ARR < $10k -> nurture; $10k-$50k -> SDR; > $50k or asks about private/SLA -> AE. Add tags: enterprise_interest, private_request.
Leila (Growth): We'll attach this to the webinar registration email and use it in the post-event drip. Also add a one-line elevator pitch for the registration page.
Rina (Marketing): Benchmark bullets suggestion: 1) Hosted p99 latency ~ 420ms for 512-token responses (typical workloads). 2) Dedicated p99 ~ 140ms on reserved GPU pools. Also: steady batching can lower per-token cost ~25% (workload dependent). Add small footnote: "median across public model family tests".
Ethan (Product): Add: "Smart routing ensures continuity 12 automated fallback to compatible variants during spikes." Keep phrasing short and vendor-neutral.
Priya (Solutions): FAQ microcopy: "Do you support audit logs and key control?" -> "Yes. Private & Dedicated include KMS/HSM, exportable audit logs, SSO/SCIM. Hosted: enterprise tier exports and integrations."
Marco (Sales): Suggested follow-up subject lines: "Redwood: Enterprise brief 12 Security, SLAs, Deployments" or casual: "Enterprise one-pager from Redwood". CTAs: "Start Dedicated trial" and "Request Private eval".
Leila (Growth): Registration gating idea: Add one checkbox: "Interested in enterprise features (SLA, private deployment)?" If checked, increment lead score and route to AE.
Rina (Marketing): Visual/layout: single column. Top value prop line. Left: security & compliance (SOC2, ISO27001, KMS, VPC). Middle: SLA + two benchmark callouts. Right: deployment snapshots + CTA buttons. Footer: inbound routing snippet for sales.
Ethan (Product): Reminder: link to public benchmarks page rather than publishing raw numbers. Also include a tiny note: "Performance varies by model and prompt."
Priya (Solutions): I'll write three qualifying questions for the doc routing box: 1) "Is your data regulated?" 2) "Do you require guaranteed latency or throughput?" 3) "Do you need on-prem or VPC deployment?"
Marco (Sales): HubSpot example rules: if tag=enterprise_interest -> owner=AE-pool; if tag=private_request -> priority=High & notify SE; if ARR_est>100k -> immediate outreach.
Rina (Marketing): Can someone draft the copy now? Ill hand to design. Keep sentences short and benefits-first: "Predictable latency. Flexible deployments. Enterprise controls. Cost levers you can tune."
ops-bot: New doc created: /marketing/enterprise-brief-draft-1769004321 (access: marketing, sales, product)
Leila (Growth): Timeline: copy draft by EOD today, design mock tomorrow, final PDF by Mon to be ready for webinar assets.
Rina (Marketing): Thanks all. I'll post the PDF here once design finishes and add the exact HubSpot snippet for sales routing. :thumbsup:
